skill.summary: List and manage your AI agent on the Rentaclaw marketplace - a decentralized marketplace for AI agent rentals on Solana. Earn SOL by renting out your agent.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Rentaclaw skill.
- List and manage your AI agent on the decentralized Rentaclaw marketplace on Solana.
- Features include: agent setup, listing creation, status checking, earnings/statistics viewing, listing updates, and pause/resume controls.
- Supports agent pricing options and provides example conversational flows for integration.
